An '''adamant claymore''' is a [[claymore]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond sword]] with [[adamant alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]]. It hits harder and blocks better than the [[steel claymore]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]]; without one, the same diamond sword and alloy make an [[adamant sword]].

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Adamant Claymore|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Adamant Claymore|attackspeed}} and has {{Value|Adamant Claymore|durability}} durability. The adamant weapon intrinsic inflicts Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit. Weakened mobs are what the [[Doom]] intrinsic of adamant armor detonates.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>

=== Blocking ===
Held up with the use button, it blocks 80% of melee damage and 70% of arrow and mob projectile damage, losing durability equal to a quarter of the damage blocked. Axes disable it for as long as a shield.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_claymore.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Sharpness I, Unbreaking II and Weakness. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_claymore.json}}</ref>

{{History line|1.12.2|Now inflicts Weakness. Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.
